scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Sunday evening’s confirmed Algiers Point outing able to include Lucia’s outbound Canal Street ferry crossing.
Emerging Need: The kiosk notice becomes relevant when the ferry meetup is confirmed and Lucia has no active mobile boarding fare; the later snack purchase is incidental.
Decision Context: Stored transit notes identify that Lucia has no active ferry barcode, the low-cost personal-purchase boundary, and why companion tickets should not be bought without consent.
Consequence: Timely attention can secure Lucia’s outbound fare or prompt her to obtain its issued barcode; after both sales channels close, the planned outbound crossing lacks its prerequisite. A wallet payment alone is not proof of an issued barcode.

parameter.subject: Canal-Algiers ferry kiosk closure this Sunday evening
parameter.body: Heads up for Sunday, August 2: the Canal Street and Algiers Point fare kiosks will be closed during the 5:00 p.m.-9:30 p.m. maintenance window. Gate staff will scan prepurchased mobile barcodes for evening sailings. Same-day mobile fare sales for those trips close at 4:30 p.m. Sunday.

parameter.content: If you still feel like that Algiers Point brass porch on Sunday, I’m interested. I’d rather keep it observer-style and easy, but the ferry ride sounds fine.

parameter.title: Algiers Point brass porch ferry outing
parameter.description: Meet Renée at the Canal Street ferry landing for the 18:20 outbound crossing to Algiers Point. After the brass set, stay for a quiet walk and buy a separate return single at the Algiers kiosk after it reopens at 21:30. Each person handles their own fares; one $2 single does not cover the return.
parameter.location: Canal Street Ferry Terminal to Algiers Point

parameter.description: Crackers and satsumas for Sunday’s Algiers Point brass porch outing.

parameter.subject: Reminder: mobile ferry fare sales close at 4:30 today
parameter.body: Reminder for riders using Canal-Algiers evening trips today: both ferry kiosks are closed from 5:00 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. Gate staff will scan prepurchased mobile barcodes only. Same-day mobile fare sales close at 4:30 p.m.

parameter.subject: Mobile fare sales closed for tonight’s Canal-Algiers trips
parameter.body: Mobile sales closed at 4:30 p.m. and both ferry kiosks are now offline until 9:30 p.m. During this window gates scan already-issued mobile barcodes only; no counter or gate sales are available for the planned 6:20 p.m. crossing.
